flamengo-crf.svg.author: Clube de Regatas do Flamengo
flamengo-crf.svg.method: Exact original white monogram path from the real club crest; no redraw, no generated lettering.

cruzeiro-estrelas.svg.method: Five original white star paths, preserving the constellation geometry; no institutional circle or crown on the shirt.

vasco-cruz.svg.method: SVG viewport and red-channel mask isolate the original red cross from the project's real club crest; no boat or full shield on the shirt.

athletico-white.svg.method: Original club mark silhouette in white, preserving its geometry for contrast on the red/black shirt.

palmeiras-camisa.svg.method: Original SVG paths with external red star omitted; square circle viewport. No lettering redrawn.

sao-paulo-camisa.svg.method: Original SPFC SVG with five regular native stars placed as on the current shirt: one red above a gold/red/red/gold row. No lettering redrawn.

coritiba-camisa.svg.method: Original CFC PNG and one native gold star from the current kit reference.

flamengo-camisa.svg.method: Original CRF SVG path plus one native gold star from the current kit reference.

internacional-camisa.svg.method: White SCI and inner circles isolated with a channel mask from the existing native institutional PNG; five native gold stars arranged against the 2026 shirt photograph. Outer institutional text omitted.

chapecoense-camisa.svg.method: Original ACF circular artwork clipped to omit four institutional stars and external ribbon ends; gold circular edge follows the 2026 shirt.

mirassol-camisa.svg.method: Original MFC letterforms isolated by channel mask and circular clip, omitting the institutional ribbon; native green circle and three stars follow the kit photograph.

vitoria-camisa.svg.method: Original ECV PNG and one native gold star from the current kit reference.
